fact: 1944年6月13日，德军向英国发射第一枚V-1飞弹（伦敦人称“Doodlebug”/嗡嗡弹），落点在肯特郡斯旺斯康比；V-1攻势从此开始，持续至1945年3月。

sources.title: The National Archives（英国国家档案馆）教学资源
sources.quote: The people of Britain called the V1 missiles 'Buzz Bombs' or 'Doodlebugs'. The first was dropped at Swanscombe in Kent on 13 June 1944.

fact: 1944–1945年间德军共向英国发射约6725枚V-1，其中2340枚击中伦敦，造成5475人死亡、约1.6万人受伤。

sources.title: The National Archives（英国国家档案馆）教学资源
sources.quote: Over 1944-45, 6,725 were launched at Britain. Of these, 2,340 hit London, causing 5,475 deaths, with 16,000 injured.

fact: 1944年9月8日德军开始向伦敦发射V-2弹道导弹；至1945年3月27日，共向伦敦与诺里奇方向发射超过1400枚V-2，造成近3000人死亡、逾6500人受伤。

sources.title: London: The Baby Blitz and V-Weapons, 1941–1945 | Historic England
sources.quote: Over 1,400 V-2s were launched towards London and Norwich between 8 September 1944 and 27 March 1945. They killed almost 3,000 people and injured over 6,500.

fact: V-2来袭前无法听到预警——居民唯一的感知就是爆炸本身，当时没有任何防御手段可拦截V-2。这使V-2成为与V-1截然不同的、无预警的持续伤亡源。

sources.title: London: The Baby Blitz and V-Weapons, 1941–1945 | Historic England
sources.quote: There was no defence against V-2s. They could not be heard approaching. The first people knew of them was the explosion.

fact: V-1攻势迫使逾100万伦敦居民撤离；飞弹与火箭同时摧毁大量住宅，城市住房存量在轰炸中持续损耗，疏散与住房短缺成为伦敦平民1944–1945年的基本生存处境。

sources.title: Hitler's Buzz Bombs | Air & Space Forces Magazine
sources.quote: killing 5,500 people, injuring 16,000, and forcing the evacuation of more than a million.

fact: 1944年6月至1945年3月，德国共向英国与欧洲目标发射约1.55万枚V-1飞弹与V-2火箭；V-1为脉冲喷气式无人飞弹，V-2为弹道导弹，是当时全新的远程无人武器，催生了盟军防空带（战斗机拦截、高射炮与拦阻气球）的战术应对。

sources.title: The V-Weapons Offensive | Royal Air Force, Centre for Air and Space Power Studies
sources.quote: Between June 1944 and March 1945, Germany launched 15,500 V-1 'flying bombs' and V-2 rockets at targets in England and Europe.

fact: V-武器攻势虽未如希特勒期望的那样通过打击民气改变战局，但它迫使伦敦大规模疏散、消耗盟军防空资源并造成住房存量损耗，是1944–1945年英国财政与重建支出的一项持续负担。

sources.title: The V-Weapons Offensive | Royal Air Force
sources.quote: While the V-weapons offensive did not succeed in meeting Hitler's aspiration of altering the course of the war by attacking the morale of the population, this belies their broader effectiveness as weapons that delivered significant strategic influence.

fact: 面对V-1，英国以战斗机拦截、高射炮与拦阻气球组成防空带应对；V-1飞机会因发动机关车而突然下坠，居民形成“听引擎声判断落点”的民间防空规则，但对无预警的V-2，民间防空规则基本失效。

sources.title: Hitler's Buzz Bombs | Air & Space Forces Magazine
sources.quote: The British had considerable success in fighting the V-1s with antiaircraft guns, fighter interceptors, and barrage balloons.
